lu_zixuan_21.name: 陸子軒
lu_zixuan_21.tag: 20yo East Asian male athlete, messy black hair, black jersey #21 with red-gold trim, knee tights, red-black sneakers

coach_gao.name: 高振峰教練
coach_gao.tag: 40yo East Asian male coach, short buzz hair with stubble, black track jacket with red-gold trim, silver whistle

shots.name: bench_edge_isolation
shots.prompt_en: Low angle slow pull-out. Lu Zi-xuan in black jersey #21 sits alone in bench shadows, hands squeezing plastic bottle into net bag. Clean sweatless jersey. Distant teammates celebrate under golden confetti. High-contrast arena lighting.
shots.prompt_zh: 低角度緩慢拉遠鏡頭。陸子軒穿著乾淨的21號黑球衣孤單坐在長椅陰影中，雙手捏緊塑料瓶塞入網袋。遠處隊友在金色彩帶狂歡，高反差球館光影。

shots.name: dawn_mist_slide
shots.prompt_en: Low-angle fast lateral tracking shot. 5:30 AM mist in empty gymnasium. Lu Zi-xuan executes rapid defensive sliding steps across reflective court, sneakers squeaking, heavy breath steam in cold air.
shots.prompt_zh: 貼地低角度快速橫向跟鏡。清晨五點半晨霧球館，陸子軒在反光木地板劇烈防守滑步，球鞋摩擦急停，口中吐出白霧喘息。

shots.name: coach_scolding
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot slowly pushing in. Coach Gao in black track jacket with red-gold trim stands sternly, sharp eagle eyes glaring, holding clipboard, pointing down at player's scraped bloody knee bandage. Dark gym shadows.
shots.prompt_zh: 中景緩慢推鏡。高教練穿黑底紅金夾克嚴厲肅立，鷹隼眼神凝視，手持戰術夾板指著球員滲血的膝蓋繃帶。沉重光影。

shots.name: defensive_steal
shots.camera: Action whip pan with low tilt
shots.prompt_en: Action whip pan shot. Lu Zi-xuan in low defensive stance locks up opposing guard during practice, lunging forward with explosive reach, fingertips cleanly slapping basketball away with court motion blur.
shots.prompt_zh: 高速甩鏡動作特寫。陸子軒壓低防守重心封堵控衛突破，迅猛伸手精準切球，木地板倒影與動態殘影。

shots.name: horizontal_diving_save
shots.prompt_en: 120fps slow-motion crash zoom. Lu Zi-xuan dives horizontally parallel to court, scooping out-of-bounds basketball back in mid-air, crashing into press tables and folding chairs, bottles flying.
shots.prompt_zh: 120幀高速慢動作俯衝特寫。陸子軒橫身平飛出界，空中單手撈回籃球，隨後撞翻技術台鐵椅，水瓶飛濺。

shots.name: starter_whiteboard
shots.prompt_en: Macro shot tilting up from whiteboard. Black marker writing '#21 LU ZI-XUAN (SF)'. Camera pans to Lu Zi-xuan in back row with teary determined eyes as teammates cheer. Warm morning sunbeams.
shots.prompt_zh: 微距上搖鏡頭。白板黑筆書寫「#21 陸子軒(SF)」，鏡頭移至後排眼眶泛紅的陸子軒，隊友拍桌歡呼，百葉窗晨曦金光。

shots.name: sunrise_center_court
shots.prompt_en: Slow dolly-in over shoulder. Back view of Lu Zi-xuan in sweat-stained #21 jersey adjusting left wristband, stepping firmly into jump-ball circle. Volumetric golden sunrise rays streaming from ceiling.
shots.prompt_zh: 過肩緩慢推進。背對鏡頭的陸子軒穿著汗濕21號球衣調整左護腕，邁步踏入中圈跳球區。金色晨曦光柱傾瀉。
